RefundPage.title: Refund Policy
RefundPage.description: Meteor Store Refund Policy and Application Process
RefundPage.intro: This policy applies to digital products purchased directly from Meteor Store. Our products provide downloadable trial versions and detailed documentation. We recommend you try before deciding to pay. Once you receive an activation code and have substantially used the product, due to the replicability of digital products, refunds are generally not provided; but the following exceptions apply.
RefundPage.section1Title: 1. Situations Where Refund Can Be Applied
RefundPage.refund1Desc: If more than 24 hours have passed after successful payment and you still haven't received the activation code or confirmation email, and we are unable to resend, a full refund is available.
RefundPage.refund2Desc: If the product's core functionality cannot be used normally under standard conditions, and we confirm the issue cannot be fixed or an alternative provided within a reasonable time, a full refund is available.
RefundPage.refund3Desc: If you have not activated the product (i.e., haven't used the activation code for any login or unlock operation) within 7 days of payment and contact us, a full refund is available.
RefundPage.refund4Desc: If a duplicate charge for the same order occurred due to system issues, the overcharged amount will be refunded unconditionally in full.
RefundPage.section2Title: 2. Situations Where Refund Is Not Available
RefundPage.noRefund1: The activation code has been activated and used, and does not fall under 'Major Functional Defect' in Section 1 of this policy;
RefundPage.noRefund2: A free trial version was available for verification before purchase, but you express 'not suitable' or 'not needed' after purchase;
RefundPage.noRefund3: Incompatibility due to user environment (OS version, hardware configuration, network conditions, etc.), and the product page or documentation clearly stated the required environment;
RefundPage.noRefund4: Your functional expectations for the product do not match what is clearly stated on the product page / documentation;
RefundPage.noRefund5: Products obtained through invitation codes, discount codes, or gifts (no payment made);
RefundPage.noRefund6: We do not currently offer auto-renewing subscriptions. If subscriptions are introduced, their refund rules will be stated separately before purchase.
RefundPage.process1: Send an email to meteor@stu.gpnu.edu.cn with the subject line 'Refund Application + Order Number'.
RefundPage.process2: Briefly explain the reason for the refund in the body, and include the order number, payment time, and payment amount (visible in order details or confirmation email).
RefundPage.process3: If it involves 'Major Functional Defect', please attach a problem description and screenshots for our verification.
RefundPage.process4: We will respond with the review result within 3 business days.
RefundPage.process5: Refunds will be returned through the original payment channel (Alipay), usually within 1-7 business days, depending on the payment channel.
RefundPage.afterRefund1: After a successful refund, the corresponding order's activation code will be immediately deactivated. You must stop using and delete the product copy (except for open source parts).
RefundPage.afterRefund2: After the refund is completed, related invoices or receipts will be simultaneously voided.
RefundPage.afterRefund3: Malicious refund requests (such as requesting a refund after extensive product use, obtaining activation codes and then requesting refunds, etc.) will be rejected, and we reserve the right to pursue legal action if necessary.
RefundPage.section5Content: This policy does not exclude mandatory rights granted to consumers by laws and regulations. If you are a consumer within the People's Republic of China, your rights under the Consumer Protection Law and other laws are not limited by this policy.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.description: Meteor Store Privacy Policy and Data Processing Statement
PrivacyPage.controllerContent: This website (imagentx.top) is operated by the sole proprietorship listed below, which acts as the handler of your personal information. We process personal information in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law and the Cybersecurity Law of the People’s Republic of China.
PrivacyPage.collectContent: We collect the following information when you use Meteor Store:
PrivacyPage.accountInfoDesc: Email address, username (when you register or make a purchase)
PrivacyPage.paymentInfoDesc: Processed through third-party payment platforms (Alipay); we do not directly store your bank card information
PrivacyPage.usageDataDesc: Product usage, access times, browser type
PrivacyPage.contactInfoDesc: When you communicate with us through contact forms or email
PrivacyPage.collectSensitiveNote: We do not collect sensitive personal information such as national ID numbers, bank card numbers, or biometric data. Payment fund details are handled directly by Alipay; we receive only the order number and payment result.
PrivacyPage.basisContent: We process your personal information on one of the following bases:
PrivacyPage.basis1: Necessary to perform a contract — delivering orders, issuing license keys, providing after-sales support
PrivacyPage.basis2: Your consent — the checkbox at registration, plus feedback, comments, and submissions you choose to send
PrivacyPage.basis3: Compliance with legal obligations — retaining transaction records under the E-Commerce Law and responding to regulators
PrivacyPage.basis4: Protection of legitimate interests — preventing fraud, abuse, and security attacks
PrivacyPage.useContent: We use the collected information to:
PrivacyPage.purpose2: Process your payments and send order confirmations
PrivacyPage.purpose3: Send product updates and service notifications
PrivacyPage.purpose4: Improve user experience and product features
PrivacyPage.purpose5: Prevent fraud and protect account security
PrivacyPage.cookieContent: We use only strictly necessary cookies, such as those maintaining your login session and language preference. We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies and do not build cross-site behavioural profiles. You can manage cookies in your browser, but disabling necessary cookies will prevent you from signing in.
PrivacyPage.shareContent: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information in the following circumstances:
PrivacyPage.share2: To complete payment processing (sharing necessary information with payment service providers)
PrivacyPage.share4: To protect our legitimate rights and interests
PrivacyPage.shareThirdPartyNote: Third-party services we currently rely on: Alipay (payment processing), Resend (transactional email), Cloudflare R2 (image storage), Vercel (site hosting), Neon (database hosting), Upstash (rate limiting), and Sentry (error monitoring).
PrivacyPage.retentionContent: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described above:
PrivacyPage.retention1: Account information — kept while the account is active, then deleted or anonymised within 30 days of closure
PrivacyPage.retention2: Transaction and invoice records — retained for at least three years from the transaction date, as required by Article 31 of the E-Commerce Law of the PRC
PrivacyPage.retention3: Server access logs — retained for no more than six months
PrivacyPage.retention4: User content such as comments and submissions — deleted or anonymised when the account is closed
PrivacyPage.crossBorderContent: Our infrastructure is provided by overseas cloud vendors (Vercel hosting, Neon database, Cloudflare R2 object storage, Resend email, Sentry error monitoring), so your account information, order records, and user content may be stored or processed outside mainland China. We protect this data through transport encryption, access controls, and data minimisation, and we require these vendors to uphold corresponding data protection obligations. If you do not accept cross-border transfers, please discontinue use of this site.
PrivacyPage.securityContent: We employ industry-standard security measures including site-wide HTTPS (TLS), salted password hashing, rate limiting, a Content Security Policy, and regular database backups. However, no method of internet transmission is 100% secure. In the event of a personal information breach, we will notify you and report to the relevant authorities as required by law.
PrivacyPage.minorsContent: This service is not directed at children under 14. If you are under 18, please read this policy and use the site together with a guardian. If we learn that we have collected a child’s personal information without prior guardian consent, we will delete it as soon as possible. Guardians who discover such a case may contact us at the email below to request deletion.
PrivacyPage.rightsContent: Under Articles 44 to 50 of the Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC, you have the following rights regarding your personal information:
PrivacyPage.right1: To know and to decide — understand how we process your information, and restrict or refuse processing
PrivacyPage.right2: To access and copy — view and download your personal data
PrivacyPage.right3: To correct and supplement — fix inaccurate or incomplete information

PathfinderPage.metaDescription: A reachable learning engine for students with limited resources. Generates executable, verifiable action paths based on time, budget, device, and network conditions.
PathfinderPage.heroSubtitle: You don't need better conditions — just find a step you can
PathfinderPage.heroDescription: For first-generation college students from county-level families: even with only a phone, fragmented time, and no mentors or paid resources, you can still get an executable, replaceable learning and internship prep path based on your real conditions.
PathfinderPage.pain1Desc: No teacher or mentor to consult long-term. Planning is left to your own trial and error, often taking detours.
PathfinderPage.pain2Desc: There's a lot online, but you don't know what suits you or in what order to learn — so you keep putting it off.
PathfinderPage.pain3Desc: Only a phone, tight data, fragmented free time — silently shut out by most courses.
PathfinderPage.pledge1Desc: Path generation, action plans, and resource recommendations are completely free for all students, forever.
PathfinderPage.pledge2Desc: No real name, school, phone, or address required. Just one goal is enough to start.
PathfinderPage.pledge3Desc: No purchases, memberships, or course sales in the results. Paths don't serve monetization.
PathfinderPage.pledge4Desc: Resource ranking prioritizes free, public, low-data content — considerate of students with limited connectivity.
PathfinderPage.privacyContent: This site doesn't ask for your name, school, phone, or address, and doesn't store input long-term. Your API Key, Base URL, and model name are stored only in the current browser session; during generation, they're sent once with your goal and conditions to the AI model service you choose. Do not enter identity info, contact details, address, or other sensitive personal info. Generated path suggestions are not commitments regarding education, employment, medical, or psychological diagnosis.
PathfinderPage.ctaTitle: Resources Shouldn't Decide How Far a Student Can Go
